The program was run from the actual staged file and its exhaustive output checked; the proof does not extrapolate from random samples.

value.rationale: The source explicitly raises stability for extremal ell_1-ball hyperplane projections but leaves numerical constants unspecified. A sharp global five-dimensional constant with a nonlocal 32-element diagonal equality orbit closes a motivated exact best-constant problem and distinguishes worst-case angular stability from local behavior. A finite certificate is only a verification tool; the geometric classification and exact coefficient are the mathematical value.
